full_judgment: Mr. Md. Delwar Hossain, J:- This rule was issued upon an application under section 5 of the Limitation Act calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the delay of 3141 days in filing the criminal appeal against the judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 27.9.2000 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge, Feni in Sessions Case No.08 of 1999 should not be condoned and/or pass such other or further orders or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper.
